messages:
Maya (Sales): Quick handoff for GranitePass. Mid-market, signed 2024-07-20, 12mo term. Dedicated trial in us-west. Onboarding ~62%. Blockers: SSO failing (Okta TLS cert error) and bulk CSV ingest returning 5xx. Renewal flagged medium risk if unresolved in 30d.

Omar (CS): I'll own onboarding and enablement. Need customer contacts, sample logs, and a slot for a 45m enablement sesh. They also want a short run on routing/cost controls.

Maya (Sales): Contacts: nate@granitepass.com (Platform Lead) and jess@granitepass.com (PM). Nate agreed to upload IdP metadata XML + one sanitized CSV to the shared onboarding folder. Intro email going out.

Ravi (Eng): Reproduced TLS error: "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority" calling their IdP. ENG-8240 opened. Fix is client config + restart of dedicated host granitepass-ded01. Need metadata XML or cert.

Jenna (Support): Creating SUPPORT-4110 and adding a synthetic monitor for ingest endpoints. Alert rule: page oncall + Ravi if 5xx rate >1% over 5m. Assigning initial triage to me.

ops-bot: Maintenance request received for granitepass-ded01. Please confirm ETA in ENG-8240.

Omar (CS): Owners & next steps: Omar = onboarding + schedule enablement (Thu 09:00 PT); Ravi = ENG-8240 apply config and plan restart; Jenna = SUPPORT-4110 monitors & escalation; Maya = customer liaison + confirm uploads and maintenance window. I'll create Jira epic CS-1288 and link ENG-8240 + SUPPORT-4110.

Maya (Sales): Nate replied: uploading metadata + CSV now. Maintenance window Tue 15:00-16:00 PT works; requests 20m pre-call.

Ravi (Eng): I can do restart Tue 15:10 PT after pre-call. PR ready; will post health checks to ENG-8240 and monitor post-restart.

Jenna (Support): Standing by for restart. If 5xx spikes >2% I'll open an incident and page oncall. SUPPORT-4110 created.

Omar (CS): I'll schedule pre-call Tue 14:40 PT and enablement Thu 09:00 PT. I'll prepare a short feedback form for the enablement session to capture adoption concerns and routing/cost questions.

Maya (Sales): Marking renewal as "monitoring" in CRM and setting 30-day adoption follow-up (tokens/day, embeddings use). Use this thread for quick updates. :thumbsup:
